notes:
FieldStitch 1.5.0 - faster processing and NVIDIA GPU support. This update needs the new installer (it adds the GPU libraries); your projects are kept.
- Feature detection runs on an NVIDIA graphics card when there is one, alongside the CPU.
- Matching about 2x faster, bundle adjustment and surface steps faster, using all cores.
- Rendering decodes each photo fewer times; overviews are written while rendering (saved as <name>.tif.ovr next to the orthomosaic) instead of in a long single-core pass at the end.
- Processing options: 'Use the NVIDIA graphics card' switch; time estimates updated from real jobs.
